components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:7px;color:var(--muted);font:550 12px var(--font-copy)}.ds-field input{min-height:44px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:450 14px var(--font-copy)}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:var(--line-strong)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px}

components.css: .ds-submitted{padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:16px;background:var(--gold-bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-copy)}.ds-submitted header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;align-items:center}.ds-submitted header span{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.ds-submitted header strong{color:var(--accent);font-size:24px;font-weight:650}.ds-submitted time{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:28px 0 24px;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}.ds-submitted time strong{font-size:80px;line-height:1;font-weight:550;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ink)}.ds-submitted h2{font-size:22px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-submitted p{font-size:18px;font-weight:600}.ds-submitted a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;font-size:13px;text-underline-offset:.22em}.ds-submitted a:hover{color:var(--accent)}.ds-submitted a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: The approved world is warm white with peach accents, clean Manrope typography, quiet borders, and restrained motion. This is an extraction of the implemented frontend; no named Creative North Star was approved.
dos: Do reuse theme-bound CSS variables, preserve visible focus, use the single Manrope hierarchy, and show real date/claim states.
donts: Don't invent availability or ownership guarantees, add decorative depth to the working calendar, or reintroduce competing font families.
